description: This class includes the manufacture of furniture and related products of any material.
includes: manufacture of chairs and seats: office chairs, household chairs, theatre seats, barbers' chairs
manufacture of office furniture: desks, bookcases, filing cabinets
manufacture of kitchen furniture: kitchen cabinets, kitchen units
manufacture of bedroom furniture: beds, wardrobes, dressing tables
manufacture of living room furniture: tables, shelving units, display cabinets
manufacture of garden furniture: outdoor chairs, tables
manufacture of wooden, metal, plastic and other furniture for retail stores, restaurants, hotels
manufacture of mattresses: spring mattresses, stuffed mattresses, cellular rubber or plastic mattresses
manufacture of furniture fittings: hinges, castors, knobs, handles
excludes: manufacture of lamps and lighting equipment, see 2740
manufacture of signs and advertising displays, see 3290
manufacture of stuffed animals (soft toys), see 3240
installation of furniture on ships, in aircraft, etc. — covered by the respective transport equipment class
